objective: Isolate the effect of the measure-correction exponent beta with fixed frozen models, adaptive sampling sets, budgets, and reconstruction.
controls: Uniform and production-beta values; beta=0 is uncompensated original Physics-Attention on the same adaptive point set
normalization: For each policy and seed, divide the trapezoidal error-budget area by its beta=0 area, then average the three ratios. Tables use matched Uniform as the rAUEC denominator.
selection: The sweep does not change the exponents used in the main experiments.
airfoil_inclusion: Fixed true pressure-force Cl > 0.02 subset, shared by field and Cd/Cl metrics.
